en_title: PlayStation Shadowdrops Saros Zenith Update With Boss Rush, New Game+ and Fancy Golden Crown Powerups
cn_title: 《沙罗周期》突袭更新，加入Boss连战
subtitle: 戴上金冠迎接试炼
opus_summary: 《沙罗周期》推出Zenith更新，加入Boss连战、新游戏＋及10种试炼修改器。阿俊可戴上金冠解锁故事条目，玩家还能使用弹幕减速、自动开火和体感瞄准等辅助功能。

paragraphs.en: A new update for Saros dropped today, adding some new features to the hectic Housemarque shooter. New Carcosan Modifiers allow players to further tweak the challenge, a boss rush mode lets you compete on leaderboards, and Arjun gets a golden glow.
paragraphs.cn: 《沙罗周期》今日推出新更新，为Housemarque这款节奏紧张的射击游戏加入了新功能。新增的Carcosan修改器让玩家能进一步调整挑战难度，Boss连战模式让玩家可以争夺排行榜名次，阿俊也将披上金色光芒。

paragraphs.en: Zenith adds 10 new Trial Modifiers to increase the challenge level. One example is “Hostile Regeneration,” which allows you to stun larger enemies, but you have to get in and finish them with a melee strike before they recover.
paragraphs.cn: Zenith更新新增了10种试炼修改器，可提升挑战难度。例如，启用「Hostile Regeneration」后，玩家可以击晕体型较大的敌人，但必须在它们恢复前近身，用近战攻击将其击杀。

paragraphs.en: The update also adds New Game+, which adds mysterious new nodes to the Armor Matrix back at Passage. You use these to move through Eclipse Layers, which ramp up the challenge with new rules and deadlier enemies.
paragraphs.cn: 更新还加入了新游戏＋模式，为Passage中的Armor Matrix增添了神秘的新节点。玩家可以利用这些节点推进Eclipse Layers，其中的新规则和更致命的敌人会进一步提升挑战难度。

paragraphs.en: During Eclipse Layers, Arjun dons a golden crown and his armor glows. The more trials you have active, the more it glows and the flashier his gilded attire gets. Wearing the crown also grants access to new story and lore entries called Visions.
paragraphs.cn: 在Eclipse Layers中，阿俊会戴上金色王冠，护甲也会发光。玩家启用的试炼越多，护甲的光芒就越亮，他的镀金装束也越华丽。戴上王冠还能解锁名为Visions的新故事与背景设定条目。

paragraphs.en: Then there’s Overlord Rush, accessed via the primary unit in Passage. This is a training simulation boss rush mode that lets you take down the fiercest Saros enemies and compete for a place on global leaderboards.
paragraphs.cn: 此外还有Overlord Rush，玩家可通过Passage中的主终端进入。这是一个以模拟训练形式展开的Boss连战模式，玩家可以挑战《沙罗周期》中最凶猛的敌人，争夺全球排行榜上的名次。

paragraphs.en: “Overlord Rush is divided into multiple Sets, each of which contains a different selection of Overlords,” the post on the PS Blog said . “The Incursion and Ascension Sets contain three Overlords each, and can be completed in 10 minutes, for a nice little Saros snack. The final Set is known as Totality. As the name implies, it lines up all eight Overlords from around Carcosa in one continuous gauntlet!”
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation博客文章写道：「Overlord Rush分为多个组别，每组都有不同的Overlord组合。Incursion和Ascension两组各有3名Overlord，10分钟就能打完，适合来上一小局《沙罗周期》。最后一组名为Totality。正如其名，这一组将Carcosa各处的全部8名Overlord串成了一场不间断的连续挑战！」

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, Housemarque has added a bunch of accessibility modifiers for people who are struggling with Saros, including the ability to slow projectiles down, giving you more time to dodge. “You have control over how much the game slows down, and can even choose if you want the setting to kick in automatically during combat, or if you want to manually toggle it on when things get hairy,” the blog said.
paragraphs.cn: 除此之外，Housemarque还为觉得《沙罗周期》难以上手的玩家加入了多种无障碍修改器，包括降低弹丸飞行速度，让玩家有更多时间闪避。博客写道：「你可以控制游戏减速的幅度，甚至可以选择让这一设置在战斗中自动生效，或是在局面棘手时手动开启。」

paragraphs.en: There’s also a new Auto Fire setting you can toggle on, which fires your weapon for you whenever you’re aiming at an enemy. You can also change the controls to aim with the motion sensor, for players who can’t get used to patting their head while rubbing their tummy and running on a treadmill at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 更新还新增了可开关的自动开火设置，开启后，只要瞄准敌人，武器就会自动射击。玩家也可以调整操作设置，使用运动传感器瞄准，适合那些不习惯一边拍脑袋、一边揉肚子、同时还得在跑步机上奔跑般多线操作的玩家。

paragraphs.en: “We here at Housemarque are super excited for everyone to get their hands on the new content Zenith adds,” Housemarque said. “I can’t wait to hear what players think about all the new control options, see your Crown-equipped Photo mode snaps, and compete (and likely lose) to your high scores in Overlord Rush.”
paragraphs.cn: Housemarque表示：「我们Housemarque全体都非常期待大家体验Zenith带来的新内容。我迫不及待地想听听玩家对这些新操作选项的看法，看看你们在照片模式下拍摄的戴着王冠的截图，再挑战一下你们在Overlord Rush中的高分（尽管很可能会输）。」
